title: Target capability descriptor
description: A target adapter's declared capabilities. Each target kind (backlog-item, initiative, plan-execution) advertises a set of capability ids; an operation contract requires capabilities, and compilation fails closed when a bound target does not provide a required capability. This is the compatibility SSOT that lets backlog-item and initiative share an operation (e.g. review-round) whenever their provided capabilities cover the contract's requirements. Capability ids are drawn from a closed vocabulary — a target may never invent one, so a mismatch is a definitive, actionable error rather than an open-world guess. This document is data; the Go compatibility validator (agentops.ValidateTargetCapabilityDescriptor / CheckOperationTargetCompatibility) interprets it.

description.description: Operator-facing summary of what this target provides.

provides.description: The closed-vocabulary capability ids this target adapter supplies.

TargetKind.description: The three registered target kinds (EXECUTION-MODES.md D1/D6). Must stay byte-identical to the operating-mode schema's target enum; a drift test enforces it.

CapabilityId.description: Closed capability vocabulary. provides-plan-ref = can bind/carry a canonical Plan Manager reference. provides-plan-context = resolves a plan execution context. provides-spec-document = has an authorable spec/item document. provides-review-artifacts = accumulates review rounds/verdicts. provides-evidence-ledger = is an evidence-ledger subject. provides-member-items = has member backlog items. provides-acceptance-criteria = declares acceptance criteria. provides-clarification-thread = supports a clarification thread. provides-execution-workspace = resolves an execution workspace/run.
